top_concerns: Test motions are the same types as the training motions, so generalization to unseen unconventional motions is never tested
No control baseline fine-tuned on the same synthetic data without the disentanglement components; the real-data comparison uses RealEstate10K, which lacks these motions
The 'optical-flow' loss is a frame-difference loss with no ablation and no lambda reported, and is not appearance-invariant
Metrics are weak: FVD around 2000 on 100 prompts, undescribed pose-estimation protocol, mixed results in Table 2, and a small MTurk study with no variance or significance
Limited novelty (AnimateDiff-style appearance LoRA plus a style tag) and a limited ablation set (no data scale, scene complexity or backbone variation)
